scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && concurrently -k -n api,worker-1,worker-2,worker-3,client -c blue,green,green,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @ratchet/workflows api" "WORKER_ID=worker-1 pnpm --filter @ratchet/workflows worker" "WORKER_ID=worker-2 pnpm --filter @ratchet/workflows worker" "WORKER_ID=worker-3 pnpm --filter @ratchet/workflows worker" "pnpm --filter @ratchet/client dev"
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
